mapper.select: SELECT ri.id, ri.return_no, ri.return_batch_no, ri.erp_order_id, ri.platform_order_id, ri.platform, ri.sku_code, ri.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, ri.return_date, ri.return_reason, ri.total_quantity, ri.qualified_quantity, ri.unqualified_quantity, ri.to_damaged_quantity, ri.scrap_quantity, ri.returnable_quantity, ri.return_status, ri.remark, ri.create_by, u.nickname AS create_by_name, ri.create_time ,DATE_FORMAT(ri.disposition_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS disposition_time ,DATE_FORMAT(ri.processed_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS processed_time FROM wms_return_inbound_order ri LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON ri.warehouse_id = w.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON ri.create_by = u.user_id WHERE ri.id = #{id} AND ri.deleted = 0

SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.platform_order_id AS platformOrderId, o.platform, o.outbound_time AS outboundTime, oi.id AS orderItemId, oi.platform_item_id AS platformItemId, COALESCE(NULLIF(oi.sku_code, ''), sm.sku_code) AS skuCode, oi.quantity AS shippedQuantity, COALESCE(oi.returned_quantity, 0) AS returnedQuantity, COALESCE(pending.in_flight_quantity, 0) AS inFlightQuantity, (oi.quantity - COALESCE(oi.returned_quantity, 0) - COALESCE(pending.in_flight_quantity, 0)) AS returnableQuantity FROM erp_order o INNER JOIN erp_order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN sku_mapping sm ON sm.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND sm.platform_item_id = oi.platform_item_id AND sm.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_item_id, SUM(total_quantity) AS in_flight_quantity FROM wms_return_inbound_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND return_status IN ('RETURN_PENDING', 'QC_PENDING') GROUP BY order_item_id ) pending ON pending.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.outbound_status = 'COMPLETED' AND (oi.quantity - COALESCE(oi.returned_quantity, 0) - COALESCE(pending.in_flight_quantity, 0)) > 0
AND (o.platform_order_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{qo.keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(NULLIF(oi.sku_code, ''), sm.sku_code) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{qo.keyword}, '%'))
AND o.platform = #{qo.platform}
ORDER BY o.outbound_time DESC

SELECT o.id AS orderId, oi.id AS orderItemId, o.tenant_id AS erpTenantId, o.platform_order_id AS platformOrderId, o.platform, o.outbound_status AS outboundStatus, COALESCE(NULLIF(oi.sku_code, ''), sm.sku_code) AS skuCode, oi.quantity AS shippedQuantity, COALESCE(oi.returned_quantity, 0) AS returnedQuantity FROM erp_order_item oi INNER JOIN erp_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN sku_mapping sm ON sm.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND sm.platform_item_id = oi.platform_item_id AND sm.deleted = 0 WHERE oi.id = #{orderItemId} AND o.tenant_id = #{erpTenantId} AND oi.tenant_id = #{erpTenantId} FOR UPDATE
